anchor.statement: Proposition 9.1. Fix a label, m ∈ Z \ {0}, and α ∈ R . Let f m ∈ W α satisfy the support and smooth- extension hypotheses of Proposition 7.2. Assume also that the source harmonic f m e ikm Φ extends smoothly by zero outside the fixed local rectangle, including its pulse endpoints. Let (t m , π m ) be the solution of L m (t m , π m ) = − f m . The same conclusions hold for a homogeneous pulse t m ∈ W α , with f m = 0. Multiply its potential and pressure by the pulse cutoff and take the curl as in (7.38). Then the normalized linear residual, after adding the prescribed source f m e ikm Φ , belongs to W α +1/2−3 κs , apart from additive pulse-cutoff tails whose Cartesian space–time derivatives vanish to infinite order as q ↓ 0. The pressure amplitude π m belongs to W α +1/2 .

correspondence.note: The residual conclusion (good part in W^{α+1/2−3κ} plus a pulse-cutoff error that is flat, also after multiplication by the carrier in physical variables) is stated, but πm ∈ W^{α+1/2} and the amplitude class W^α are hypotheses (InputBounds.pressure, InputBounds.amplitude) rather than conclusions. The homogeneous case is the instance source = 0.
